beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: On the sabbath day, Jesus went into the synagogue at Capernaum and stood up to teach. The people had gathered as they always did, to hear the scriptures taught and explained by the teachers they knew.

timing.text: On the sabbath day, Jesus went into the synagogue at Capernaum and stood up to teach.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: But this was different. He taught them as one who had authority of his own, not leaning on teacher after teacher the way the scribes did. His words carried a quiet weight, and the whole room felt it, and was astonished.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: There in the congregation was a man held by an unclean spirit. Something dark had bound him for a long time, and the nearness of Jesus stirred it. Unable to stay silent any longer, he suddenly cried out.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: And the voice that broke out of him was not his own.

beats.speaker: scripture
beats.text: Let us alone; what have we to do with thee, thou Jesus of Nazareth? art thou come to destroy us? I know thee who thou art, the Holy One of God.

beats.text: Leave us alone. And then, almost trembling: Sit with that for a second. In a room full of religious people, the first one to say out loud exactly who he was, was the darkness.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: Be quiet, and come out of him. Just a few short words. There was no long battle, no struggle of equals. At his word the spirit shook the man one last time, cried out with a loud voice, and came out of him. The thing that had held him for so long simply had to go.

beats.text: And the man was free. The torment had drained from his face, and he stood there quiet and whole, himself again, like someone waking gently from a long and terrible dream.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: And right away the news of him went out everywhere, through all the country round about Galilee. Wherever the story was carried, people heard that one had come whose word even the darkness could not resist.

card.text: The same voice that spoke into that man's torment still speaks today. There is no darkness in you so deep that his word cannot reach it, and nothing holding you that has to stay when he says come out. What is he asking you to let him set free?
